sloka: स एव संशयस्तात तव तस्य च यद्बले ।सालमेकं तु निर्भिद्या भवेद्व्यक्तिर्बलाबले ॥४-११-९०॥।।
transliteration: sa eva saṁśayastāta tava tasya ca yadbale ।sālamekaṁ tu nirbhidyā bhavedvyaktirbalābale ॥4-11-90॥।।

translations.english: 'O Dear, therefore, I have my doubt about your relative strength. If you can split a sala tree with a single arrow then can your strength or weakness be demonstrated.
